purpose: Freeze the exact state, temporal-factor, coordinate-frame, clock-dimension, and optimizer differences before any opt-in change or new truth read.

policy.ground_truth: development-train only, after a candidate freeze and sealed truth-free output
policy.base_compensation: forbidden; no base observation dependency is inferred

facts: state initialization is ENU position and ENU velocity
clock state is a seven-element vector and drift is one element
PseudorangeFactor_XC and DopplerFactor_VD receive initial ENU state values
ordinary TDCP factors use the declared dt/initial-position contract
P/D/L masks and signal factors are setting-dependent
motion and clock sigmas are published parameters

PseudorangeFactor_XC.h.contract: los transpose times (x-inix) plus hc transpose times c minus residual; Jacobian is [los,hc]

DopplerFactor_VD.h.contract: los transpose times (v-iniv) plus d minus residual; Jacobian is [los,1]

ClockFactor_CCDD.h.contract: c2-c1 with only clock component zero coupled to (d1+d2)*dt/2; seven-dimensional clock vector

TDCPFactor_XXDD.h.contract: position increments relative to each initial position plus dt-scaled drift

TDCPFactor_XXCC.h.contract: position increments relative to each initial position plus clock-vector difference

state_contract.coordinate_frame: ECEF local corrections around each epoch native SPP seed
state_contract.temporal_dt: implicitly 1 second in computeCost and buildNormalEquation
state_contract.measurement_initial_state_subtraction: not represented as an explicit upstream iniv/orgv contract; raw residuals are modeled around SPP seeds
state_contract.backend: custom deterministic Eigen sparse normal-equation IRLS/line-search solver
state_contract.robust_loss: local Huber loss; not GTSAM m-estimator parity

gap_matrix.upstream: MotionFactor_XXVV and ClockFactor_CCDD scale midpoint velocity/drift by actual dtgps and omit factors when dtgps >= 1.5 s
gap_matrix.native: motion and clock residuals use an implicit unit interval for every adjacent stored epoch
gap_matrix.exact_gap: actual epoch spacing is not represented in the native temporal residual/Jacobian
gap_matrix.safe_candidate: opt-in actual-dt temporal contract; default path remains byte-compatible
gap_matrix.risk: low on exactly 1 Hz data; changes physics on jitter/gap data

gap_matrix.upstream: states and LOS are ENU relative to one initial origin; P/D/TDCP factors subtract initial ENU position/velocity
gap_matrix.native: state is ECEF correction around each epoch seed; LOS is ECEF and no explicit initial-velocity subtraction is stored
gap_matrix.exact_gap: a full ENU/global-origin rewrite and factor-level initial-state contract are required for equivalence
gap_matrix.safe_candidate: not attempted in this small phase; requires separate factor parity proof
gap_matrix.risk: high; frame/state rewrite can change every output

gap_matrix.upstream: seven-element c vector, with component zero as receiver clock and system-specific index selected by sigtype
gap_matrix.native: five constellation clock groups selected by clockGroup(system)
gap_matrix.exact_gap: signal/frequency clock indexing and seven-column state are not represented
gap_matrix.safe_candidate: not attempted; raw supported constellation coverage does not prove all upstream sigtype columns
gap_matrix.risk: high; requires state-size and factor-index migration

gap_matrix.upstream: GTSAM nonlinear factors with published robust diagonal noise and Levenberg-Marquardt
gap_matrix.native: custom Eigen sparse IRLS with local Huber and line-search acceptance
gap_matrix.exact_gap: backend damping, robust cost, factor Jacobian/state semantics, and termination are not equivalent
gap_matrix.safe_candidate: not replaced without a factor-by-factor parity harness
gap_matrix.risk: high; backend substitution can mask model errors

gap_matrix.upstream: correct_pseudorange.m applies base-observation compensation before graph construction
gap_matrix.native: base inputs are forbidden by the raw-only contract
gap_matrix.exact_gap: the upstream correction cannot be derived from raw phone GNSS and broadcast nav alone
gap_matrix.safe_candidate: remain unavailable; no substitute or truth-derived correction
gap_matrix.risk: high; importing base/result coordinates would violate the no-MAT/raw-only contract

parameters_changed: none; dt is read from raw epoch timestamps
decision_before_scoring.development_score_gate: all four diagnostic variants must be <= retained v1 proxy (68.05 m best variant); no route/aggregate regression is promotable
decision_before_scoring.promotion: development-only opt-in only if gate passes; production default remains unchanged
